theologicalConcerns: ¶12 (English source): "the Vedas, which He Himself created" — in Sri Vaishnava doctrine the Vedas are eternal and not authored (apaurusheya); the Lord manifests or reveals them rather than creating them. The Kannada "ತಾನೇ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ ವೇದಗಳ" faithfully follows the English; the owner may wish to revise the English (compare ¶4 "came forth from His breath").
